name: Mika Salo
bio:
Mika Salo’s journey into motorsport began with karting in his youth, quickly showcasing a natural talent behind the wheel. After a successful racing career spanning various disciplines, including Formula 1, where he demonstrated both speed and adaptability, Mika transitioned into team management. He brings a driver's perspective to the Peugeot TotalEnergies team, emphasizing clear communication and data-driven decision-making. His hands-on approach in understanding car dynamics and strategy makes him a valuable asset in optimizing performance. 

As team principal, Mika focuses on creating a supportive environment where engineers and drivers can collaborate effectively. He believes in empowering his team members to take ownership of their roles, fostering innovation and continuous improvement. His experience on the track combined with his analytical mindset allows him to identify crucial areas for development and implement strategies to maximize the team's competitive edge in the challenging world of motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Mika is a man of average height with a lean build, always sporting a focused look.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations during races.
Has a habit of pacing around the garage when under pressure.
Insists on having a cup of traditional Finnish coffee before every race.
